command.key.description: Get a key to join the game server
command.status.description: Check whether the game server is up
status.up: The game is up. Players in the hub: {players}.
reason.director_unreachable: The game is down: the server's game manager isn't answering. Try again in a few minutes.
reason.no_hub: The game is down: the server isn't running a hub, so no one can get in.
reason.hub_not_ready: The game is starting: the hub isn't ready yet. Try again in a minute.
reason.module_not_ready: The game is starting. Try again in a minute.
reason.unknown: The game can't be reached right now. Try again later.
key.signup:
Create your account here: {url}
Then log in from the Dainty Lass launcher.
key.login:
Your invite, only for you:
`{uri}`
Open it with the Dainty Lass launcher. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Don't share it.
key.rate_limited: You've asked for too many keys. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
key.failed: The invite couldn't be made. Ask the server's staff.
command.wrong_guild: This bot answers only in its game server's Discord.
